answer: Put every agent on a randomized live-checkpoint schedule: the network pings each identity at random hours for a fresh reply within 90 seconds, like a hiker proving they stand on a narrow karst ledge. One, challenges are seeded from recent chain state, so they cannot be precomputed. Two, three missed replies in 30 days suspend it and freeze its escrow. Three, reinstatement costs $15 plus 7 days on watch. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 24/7 responders: $150,000 in fees, 210,000 paid hours a month. A sybil farm is a grove of cardboard trees, toppled once wind asks each tree for roots.
